patches_modified.name: Audio and video switch
patches_modified.description: Adds a song and video switch to the top of the player, as in YouTube Music: one tap plays a song's music video, or the song again, in the same place in the queue. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Battery saver
patches_modified.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: DJ mode
patches_modified.description: Orders upcoming tracks by measured key and tempo. Choose Steady, Build up or Wind down, use longer AutoMix blends for compatible keys, or save the order to a local playlist. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Equaliser per output
patches_modified.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Headphone correction
patches_modified.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches_modified.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

patches_modified.name: JamesDSP
patches_modified.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches_modified.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Loudness level
patches_modified.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches_modified.description: Adds signed-out playlist links, editable device copies, queue saving, native file import and reviewed two-way Spotify/YouTube Music playlist sync. Keeps files and streams together with full source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Per-download quality
patches_modified.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Pitch control
patches_modified.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Play alongside other apps
patches_modified.description: Keeps the music playing when another app plays sound, such as a reel or a video, instead of pausing. Calls still pause it. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches_modified.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches_modified.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Smart downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads the songs you play most, on Wi-Fi, so they're there without a signal. Uses BitChord's listening statistics and its Download quality; songs you delete aren't downloaded again. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Steady playback
patches_modified.description: Reads further ahead, through the rest of the song and into the next ones, with separate limits for Wi-Fi and mobile data, and waits through a lost signal instead of stopping. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Streamseek previews
patches_modified.description: Preview explicitly selected Soulseek audio while it transfers: FLAC, WAV/AIFF, ALAC, APE, WavPack, TTA/TAK, WMA Lossless and DSD, plus MP3. A dedicated on-device FFmpeg decoder feeds Media3. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.

patches_modified.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches_modified.description: Adds player-integrated Downloads on BitChord 1.9, addon/Soulseek source choices, batch review, selected-file public Soulseek sharing, and verified Telegram archiving/restore. Telegram copies require the optional Telegram patch and your private main channel. Debrid services use your API keys. Live Soulseek playback stays disabled. Settings are in Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches_modified.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

patches_modified.name: App name
patches_modified.description: Changes the app name shown in the headset's library and in app info. The stock name is just "YouTube", which is easy to confuse with the store app.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts every video at one resolution instead of the app's per-video choice; a resolution the video lacks falls back to its highest available (8K included when the stream spoof provides it). patches_modified.name: Extension
patches_modified.description: Injects the extension the other patches run through: its streaming spoof is what removes the pre-roll (ad-free playback) and provides the 8K format support. Turning this patch off restores ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides video ads, including the pre-roll when the streaming spoof is unavailable and the app falls back to its own player response.

patches_modified.name: Install as clone
patches_modified.description: Installs the patched app as a separate app by default, so it sits alongside the store's YouTube VR instead of replacing it. Replace mode keeps the official package name: the store copy has to be removed to satisfy the signing difference, Horizon OS then treats this build as the YouTube VR app (a restore prompt, and a warning on every reboot), and a store update will collide with it because this build is signed differently.

patches_modified.name: Patch settings
patches_modified.description: Builds the in-headset "Patch settings" hub and the SponsorBlock settings screen. The resource half of the SponsorBlock patch, which mines what this patch restructures the XML with.

patches_modified.name: QUIC (HTTP/3)
patches_modified.description: Adds the in-headset switch for QUIC, the transport under HTTP/3: TLS over UDP, used for this app's API and media requests. Leave it on unless playback stalls on a network that blocks or throttles UDP 443 (corporate Wi-Fi, many VPNs), where turning it off forces TCP/TLS. A change applies after the app restarts.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Removes the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_added.description: Allows exporting projects that use Pro features by bypassing the Pro gate in the export pipeline.

patches_added.name: Keyflow Trusted Signer Bypass
patches_added.description: Always report the app signature as trusted so Pro is not reset when opening a project or exporting.

patches_added.name: Keyflow byYKY0yXO Signer Bypass
patches_added.description: Return a dummy signer identity string during export so the export path does not fail on re-signed APKs.

patches_added.name: [Export] 1 kts6dAU4 Gate
patches_added.description: Always allow Pro features in the export Pro gate (Lkts6dAU4.NMGZ06).

patches_added.name: [Export] 2 kts6dAU4 Throw
patches_added.description: Do not throw the Pro-required exception (LwNKvkk7) during export.

patches_added.name: [Export] 3 y88yfJ73C Allow
patches_added.description: Always let the export pass the LCtCUGg.y88yfJ73C abort check.

patches_added.name: [Export] 4 ZFJe6vx50 Skip
patches_added.description: Never take the export-abort branch in LZFJe6vx50.invoke.

patches_added.name: [Export] 5 kCg72Z4t State
patches_added.description: Publish PLAYING instead of PRO_REQUIRED/ERROR as export state.

patches_added.name: [Export] 6 LCWcMAXf Error
patches_added.description: Replace the pre-export error message with an empty string.

patches_added.name: [Export] 7 LsvcJNUbK3 Allow
patches_added.description: Always allow the LsvcJNUbK3 sub-check of the export Pro gate.

patches_added.name: [Export] 8 Diagnostics
patches_added.description: Log the whole export flow to logcat (tag KFPro). Read with: adb logcat -s KFPro

patches_added.name: [Export] 9 Toast
patches_added.description: Show a toast naming the reason the export was cancelled.
